notes:
{提灯|ちょうちん} is a traditional Japanese lantern made of paper over a collapsible bamboo frame.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Paper lanterns are iconic symbols of Japanese festivals (⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧) and traditional establishments.

- ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧{提灯|ちょうちん}: red lantern (marks izakayas, yakitori shops)
- ⟦{盆|ぼん}→盆：03897_bon⟧{提灯|ちょうちん}: Obon festival lantern
- ⟦{小田原|おだわら}→小田原：noentry⟧{提灯|ちょうちん}: collapsible travel lantern
